# Benchmarks

<!-- Generated by `bench/ppbench.py publish` from bench/results/reference.json. Don't edit by hand. -->

Measured on Apple M6, macOS 27.0.1 on 2026-10-29 at commit `ff9c632`. Each number is the median of 5 launches after a warm-up launch.

## Opening a file with the app not running

From the `open` command. Apple's app is timed until its window appears; its content may arrive later. Preview++ is timed until its content is drawn. Both are warm launches (not the first after a reboot).

| File | Apple's app | Apple: window | Preview++: content | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Markdown, 1 KB | TextEdit | 286 ms | 285 ms | about the same |
| Markdown, 844 KB | TextEdit | 286 ms | 472 ms | 1.7× slower |
| PDF, 3 pages | Preview | 419 ms | 295 ms | 1.4× faster |
| PDF, 2,000 pages | Preview | 661 ms | 305 ms | 2.2× faster |
| PNG, 512×512 | Preview | 399 ms | 298 ms | 1.3× faster |
| JPEG, 12 MP | Preview | 394 ms | 368 ms | about the same |
| HEIC, 12 MP | Preview | 431 ms | 385 ms | 1.1× faster |
| PNG, 48 MP | Preview | 1102 ms | 675 ms | 1.6× faster |

## Quick look panel (Space in Finder)

The app is running. *Plugin running*: its process is already up. *Plugin started on demand*: the process was stopped first, as after a minute idle.

| File | Plugin running | Plugin started on demand |
|---|---|---|
| Markdown, 1 KB | 27 ms | 42 ms |
| Markdown, 844 KB | 258 ms | 269 ms |
| PDF, 3 pages | 14 ms | 18 ms |
| PDF, 2,000 pages | 27 ms | 30 ms |
| PNG, 512×512 | 20 ms | 46 ms |
| JPEG, 12 MP | 125 ms | 138 ms |
| HEIC, 12 MP | 162 ms | 161 ms |
| PNG, 48 MP | 425 ms | 443 ms |

## Plugin processes

*Startup cost*: how much longer the plugin's reply takes when its process has to start first. *Memory*: the plugin process's footprint with the file open.

| File | Startup cost | Memory |
|---|---|---|
| Markdown, 1 KB | 15 ms | 2.9 MB |
| Markdown, 844 KB | 16 ms | 40.2 MB |
| PDF, 3 pages | 8 ms | 4.9 MB |
| PDF, 2,000 pages | 6 ms | 5.3 MB |
| PNG, 512×512 | 19 ms | 4.3 MB |
| JPEG, 12 MP | 20 ms | 8.4 MB |
| HEIC, 12 MP | 25 ms | 28.3 MB |
| PNG, 48 MP | 30 ms | 19.4 MB |

## Caveats

- One machine, warm launches. Cold launches after a reboot are slower for every app.
- Apple's content-drawn time isn't measured (it needs screen recording), so the gap to Apple is likely larger than shown.
- TextEdit shows Markdown as raw text; Preview++ renders it.
- Plugin memory varies between runs by up to 2× for large files; it isn't a precise number.

## Reproducing

Quit Preview and TextEdit, then `scripts/build.sh && bench/ppbench.py run && bench/ppbench.py publish`. Raw samples are in `bench/results/reference.json`.
